name: g4.GetScreenshot
title: Capture The Virtual Desktop
description: Captures the full virtual desktop as an MCP image content block and returns the original encoded PNG dimensions and physical desktop origin as structured content. Clients may render a scaled preview; map preview coordinates back to original image pixels before adding originX and originY for a physical recorder coordinate.

metricsOnly.description: When true, skips the pixel capture and returns only virtual-desktop bounds.

width.description: Exact width in pixels of the original encoded PNG and captured virtual desktop. This is not a client-rendered preview width.

height.description: Exact height in pixels of the original encoded PNG and captured virtual desktop. This is not a client-rendered preview height.

originX.description: Physical desktop X coordinate represented by original PNG pixel x=0. After scaling a preview point to the original image grid, physicalX = originX + imagePixelX.

originY.description: Physical desktop Y coordinate represented by original PNG pixel y=0. After scaling a preview point to the original image grid, physicalY = originY + imagePixelY.
